name: Calendar True End-to-End
author: Paulhenry Saux & Community
description: End-to-end OpenPGP for webmail: sign and encrypt outgoing messages, and automatically verify signatures and decrypt incoming PGP mail. Private keys are encrypted at rest with a passphrase, and unlocked into non-extractable WebCrypto keys that never leave your browser. Runs in the privileged (same-origin) plugin tier so all cryptography happens locally.

removeWhenError.label: Don't show events that cannot be decrypted
removeWhenError.description: This option will remove events that cannot be decrypted from the calendar view. If disabled, events will be shown, with the risk of corrupt data if you edit them.

en.hint.master_unavailable: Master key unavailable. This happens if you don't use a compatible master plugin, like PGP True End-to-End or Aurion PGP or if you didn't imported/created a PGP key in those master plugin for this account.
en.hint.master_locked: Master key is locked. Please unlock your private key.
en.hint.master_unlocked_keys_not_loaded: Master keys are unlocked, but calendar keys are not loaded.
